title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Drawing Practice
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: In technical drawing, the T-square is primarily used for drawing:
questions.explain: The T-square slides along the edge of the drawing board to draw accurate horizontal lines and support set-squares.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: The standard size of a drawing board typically corresponds to drawing paper sizes. Which is larger?
questions.explain: Paper sizes follow the A-series where A0 is the largest (1 square meter). A1 is half of A0, A2 is half of A1, and so on.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which pair of set-squares is standard in a drawing instrument set?
questions.explain: Standard set-squares come in two types: the $30^{\circ}-60^{\circ}$ triangle and the $45^{\circ}$ triangle (both have a $90^{\circ}$ angle as well).
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: A line drawn with long dashes separated by short gaps ( $--$ $​-$ $--$ $​-$ ) typically represents:
questions.explain: Dashed lines represent hidden edges or details that are not visible from the current view.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which drawing instrument is used to transfer measurements from a scale to the drawing paper?
questions.explain: Dividers have two sharp points and are used to step off lengths or transfer measurements accurately.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: The angle formed by the intersection of perpendicular lines is:
questions.explain: Perpendicular lines meet at a right angle, which is $90^{\circ}$.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: To draw a circle of diameter 100mm, the compass radius must be set to:
questions.explain: Radius is half of the diameter. $r = \frac{d}{2} = \frac{100}{2} = 50\text{mm}$.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Isometric drawing represents objects in 3D using axes inclined at what angle to the horizontal?
questions.explain: Isometric projection uses a vertical axis and two receding axes at $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which grade of pencil is the hardest and produces the lightest line?
questions.explain: Pencil hardness is graded by H (Hard) and B (Black/Soft). The higher the H number, the harder the lead. 4H is harder and lighter than 2H, HB, or 2B.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: A regular polygon with five sides is called a:
questions.explain: A pentagon has 5 sides. Hexagon=6, Heptagon=7, Octagon=8.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: What is the sum of angles in a triangle?
questions.explain: The sum of the interior angles of any plane triangle is always $180^{\circ}$.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: In technical drawing, a scale of 1:2 indicates that the drawing is:
options: Enlarged to twice the size of the object
Reduced to half the size of the object
The same size as the object
questions.explain: A scale of 1:2 is a reduction scale, meaning 1 unit on the drawing represents 2 units on the actual object.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which projection method shows objects with one face parallel to the drawing plane and receding lines at $45^{\circ}$?
questions.explain: Oblique projection typically draws the front face true to shape and projects depth at an angle of $45^{\circ}$.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: The instrument used for measuring angles that cannot be drawn with set-squares is the:
questions.explain: A protractor is a semicircular instrument graduated in degrees used for measuring and plotting specific angles.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: In Orthographic projection, the Plan view is usually projected onto the:
questions.explain: The Plan (top view) is projected onto the Horizontal Plane, while the Elevation (front view) is on the Vertical Plane.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: To bisect a line segment AB means to:
options: Divide it into three equal parts
Draw a line parallel to it
Divide it into two equal parts
questions.explain: Bisection involves dividing a line, angle, or shape into two strictly equal parts.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which type of triangle has all three sides of different lengths?
questions.explain: A scalene triangle has no equal sides and no equal angles. Equilateral has 3 equal sides; Isosceles has 2.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: A line that touches the circumference of a circle at only one point without crossing it is called a:
questions.explain: A tangent is a straight line that touches a curve or circle at a single point.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: The symbol for First Angle Projection looks like a truncated cone where the circle is on the:
questions.explain: In the standard First Angle projection symbol, the two concentric circles (representing the end view) are placed to the right of the trapezoid (side view of the cone).
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: When constructing a regular hexagon given the length of one side, the radius of the circumscribing circle is:
questions.explain: The side length of a regular hexagon is exactly equal to the radius of its circumscribing circle.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Thin continuous lines are typically used in technical drawing for:
questions.explain: Thick continuous lines are for visible outlines. Thin continuous lines are for dimensions, extension lines, and construction lines.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: A quadrilateral with only one pair of parallel sides is called a:
questions.explain: A trapezium (or trapezoid in US English) is defined as a quadrilateral with at least one pair of parallel sides.
questions.subject: Basic Technology
